draft.text: You came in because you have been feeling tired, having chills, and experiencing wheezing when you are active.
We found that you have a history of iron deficiency anemia and you have been taking iron pills for about a year.
You also take over-the-counter vitamin B12 supplements.
You are not sure why you are still having these symptoms.
You have not had any tests for malabsorption syndromes, like celiac disease, or imaging studies of your small bowel.
You plan to ask about testing for malabsorption syndromes and small bowel imaging studies at your next appointment.
We will discuss the next steps then.
